name: run_scrna_qc
description: Run single-cell RNA quality control on an .h5ad dataset. Performs MAD-based outlier detection on total counts, gene counts, and mitochondrial percentage. Generates three QC plots and returns a filtered dataset. Defaults to the pre-staged PBMC3k dataset if no input is provided.

input_s3_key.description: S3 key for the input .h5ad file. Defaults to pre-staged PBMC3k if omitted.

mad_counts.description: MAD threshold for total counts. Default 5.

mad_genes.description: MAD threshold for gene counts. Default 5.

mt_threshold.description: Hard upper threshold for MT %. Default 8.

min_cells.description: Min cells for gene filtering. Default 20.

name: run_scvi_analysis
description: Run scvi-tools single-cell analysis. Validates model selection against data type, checks required parameters, and returns results. Supports: scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI. Provide input_s3_key to run live compute on your .h5ad file via ECS Fargate.

input_s3_key.description: S3 key for the input .h5ad file (e.g. 'datasets/pbmc3k_raw.h5ad'). When provided, runs live compute on Fargate and returns a Job ID.

labels_key.description: Column in .obs for cell type labels. Required for scANVI.

protein_expression.description: Whether protein data is available. Required for totalVI.

spatial_data.description: S3 key for spatial data. Required for DestVI.

sc_reference.description: S3 key for scRNA reference. Required for DestVI.

name: submit_scverse_job
description: Submit a long-running scverse analysis job. The job runs asynchronously on ECS Fargate. Returns a job_id for status tracking.

input_s3_key.description: S3 key for the input .h5ad file.

notification_email.description: Email for SNS notification on completion.

name: check_job_status
description: Check the status of a submitted scverse analysis job.

name: get_job_results
description: Retrieve output presigned URLs for a completed scverse job.

job_id.description: Job ID of the completed job.

name: list_datasets
description: List .h5ad datasets available in the storage bucket. Returns file names, sizes, and upload dates. Use this to discover datasets before running analyses.

prefix_filter.description: Optional prefix to narrow results (e.g., 'spatial/'). Searches under datasets/ by default.

next_token.description: Pagination token from a previous list_datasets call.
